name: SearXNG
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: SearXNG is a private metasearch engine: it asks Google, Bing, DuckDuckGo and many others at once, without tracking or profiling the people who search. Installs the chosen commit, and keeps your settings.yml between updates.
startup: [ -f searxng/searx/webapp.py ] || { echo "SearXNG isn't installed: reinstall the server."; exit 1; }; want="$(cat searxng/requirements.txt searxng/requirements-server.txt | sha256sum | cut -c1-16) $(python3 --version) $(uname -m)"; if [ "$want" != "$(cat .venv/.raptor-installed 2>/dev/null)" ]; then echo "Installing SearXNG's Python packages."; export TMPDIR=/home/container/.raptor-build; rm -rf $TMPDIR; mkdir -p $TMPDIR; { python3 -m venv --clear .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -q --no-cache-dir --disable-pip-version-check -r searxng/requirements.txt -r searxng/requirements-server.txt && echo "$want" > .venv/.raptor-installed; } || { rm -rf $TMPDIR; echo "SearXNG's Python packages couldn't be installed."; exit 1; }; rm -rf $TMPDIR; unset TMPDIR; fi; export SEARXNG_SETTINGS_PATH=/home/container/settings.yml SEARXNG_PORT={{SERVER_PORT}} SEARXNG_BIND_ADDRESS=0.0.0.0; for v in SEARXNG_BASE_URL SEARXNG_CONTACT_URL SEARXNG_VALKEY_URL; do [ -n "${!v}" ] || unset $v; done; cd searxng && exec ../.venv/bin/granian --interface wsgi --host 0.0.0.0 --port {{SERVER_PORT}} --no-ws --blocking-threads 4 --workers-kill-timeout 30 searx.webapp:app

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# SearXNG: downloads its source (the newest commit, or the one chosen) into
# searxng/, replacing only that folder. Its Python packages are installed when
# the server starts, into .venv. settings.yml is made once, with a random
# secret key, and never touched again.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
repo=https://github.com/searxng/searxng
work=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
rm -rf "$work" && mkdir -p "$work/src"
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT

want="${VERSION:-latest}"
if [ "$want" = latest ]; then
    commit=$(git ls-remote "$repo" refs/heads/master | cut -f1) || fail "GitHub can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
    [ -n "$commit" ] || fail "SearXNG's master branch wasn't found."
else
    commit="$want"
fi

if [ -f searxng/searx/webapp.py ] && [ "$(cat searxng/.raptor-commit 2>/dev/null)" = "$commit" ]; then
    echo "SearXNG ${commit:0:9} is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading SearXNG ${commit:0:9}."
    cd "$work/src"
    git init -q
    git fetch -q --depth 1 "$repo" "$commit" 2>/dev/null || fail "SearXNG has no commit $commit. Set Version to latest, or to a full commit hash from $repo/commits/master."
    git checkout -q FETCH_HEAD
    # The version SearXNG shows, as its own release script freezes it.
    v=$(git show -s --date='format:%Y.%m.%d' --format='%cd+%h' | sed 's/\.0/./g')
    printf 'VERSION_STRING = "%s"\nVERSION_TAG = "%s"\nDOCKER_TAG = "%s"\nGIT_URL = "%s"\nGIT_BRANCH = "master"\n' "$v" "$v" "${v/+/-}" "$repo" > searx/version_frozen.py
    mkdir -p "$work/new"
    cp -a searx requirements.txt requirements-server.txt LICENSE "$work/new/"
    echo "$commit" > "$work/new/.raptor-commit"
    echo "$v" > "$work/new/.raptor-version"
    cd /mnt/server
    rm -rf searxng.old
    [ ! -e searxng ] || mv searxng searxng.old
    mv "$work/new" searxng
    rm -rf searxng.old
fi

if [ ! -f settings.yml ]; then
    key=$(head -c 32 /dev/urandom | base64 | tr -dc 'A-Za-z0-9')
    cat > settings.yml <<EOF
# SearXNG's settings: https://docs.searxng.org/admin/settings/
# Only what differs from SearXNG's defaults goes here. The port, limiter,
# image proxy, public instance and address come from the server's Startup
# settings.
use_default_settings: true

general:
  instance_name: "SearXNG"

server:
  secret_key: "$key"

search:
  # Add json to let apps such as Open WebUI search through this instance.
  formats:
    - html
EOF
    echo "Made settings.yml with a new secret key."
fi
echo "Installed SearXNG $(cat searxng/.raptor-version). Its Python packages are installed when the server starts."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The SearXNG commit to install: latest for the newest, or a full commit hash. SearXNG has no releases; reinstall the server to update it.

variables.name: Public address
variables.description: The full address people open SearXNG at, for links and the search engine people add to their browser.

variables.name: Contact address
variables.description: How the instance's admin can be reached, such as mailto:admin@example.com. Wikipedia, Wikidata and OpenStreetMap results need it.

variables.name: Image proxy
variables.description: Load result images through this server, so the sites they come from don't see who is searching.

variables.name: Limiter
variables.description: Block bots that flood the instance with searches. Needs a Valkey or Redis server, set below.

variables.name: Valkey address
variables.description: A Valkey or Redis server for the limiter, such as valkey://203.0.113.5:6379/0.

variables.name: Public instance
variables.description: Turn on the protections for an instance anyone can use. Needs the limiter.
